Rebecca Denham (Deputy Director Export Service Design & Delivery)
🚨 I'm hiring a Head of Business Growth Advisers (G6) 🚨
This is a standout opportunity to lead a major national transformation in how UK SMEs access export support—right at the heart of the UK’s growth mission.
You’ll shape a digital-first, data-driven advisory service, lead a network of ~70 colleagues across the UK, and work closely with ministers, senior leaders and partners to deliver real impact for businesses.
If you’re a strategic leader who thrives in complexity, loves driving change, and can turn big ambition into delivery, we want to hear from you.
📍 Based in one of DBT’s UK hubs
📅 Don’t miss the closing date 14 June
👉 Apply and help us redefine how we support businesses to grow and export.

Huw Sayer (Chief Engagement Officer | Writing without the piffle: turning business ideas into brand stories for real people. — Business Writers Limited — Norwich, United Kingdom)
